words.gloss_range: two gardens intensely dark-green, with greenness driven toward blackness by lush saturation; not merely ordinary green, plain black, or an event of external blackening
words.root_gloss_range: the root field includes darkening/blackness, dense massing, sudden overwhelming onset, dark calamity, and specialized dark-name uses; locally the intensive color participle selects saturated dark-green state, while overwhelming onset survives only as a narrowed rhetorical pressure
words.prose: {{ar:مُدْهَآمَّتَانِ}} ({{tr:mudhāmmatāni}}) is a whole ayah compressed into one dual feminine nominative participle. Its ending points back to the two gardens introduced in 55:62 across the intervening refrain, so the single word is not unattached: it can complete the earlier noun, predicate a recoverable dual subject, or restate the pair by their defining visible quality. The Form IX/XI color shape makes the gardens bear an inherent state of near-black greenness, a density of living foliage rather than the absence of light. Because {{ar:د ه م}} ({{tr:d-h-m}}) also has an overwhelming-onset branch, the image can press back against the denial formula around it, but that pressure is secondary to the local color predicate. The one-word placement between refrains in 55:63 and 55:65 turns the color into the presented evidence, while the same-surah contrasts with 55:48, 55:66, and 55:76 show that this is not ordinary decorative green but the saturated color member of the garden-pair series. The long vowel, doubled middle consonant, and final dual closure give the brief ayah acoustic weight, and the hapax status leaves this single participle carrying the Quranic force of the root.

topics.headline: dual agreement reaches back to the garden pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the one-word ayah is grammatically tied to the two gardens in 55:62 rather than starting a new isolated subject.
topics.reason: The bundle alignment and attachment evidence both identify the word as a dual feminine description with the just-mentioned two gardens as discourse topic; the -tāni ending carries duality, feminine agreement, and nominative case across the intervening refrain.

topics.headline: one form can describe, predicate, and specify
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the short ayah is not grammatically thin; its single nominative descriptor can work as modifier, predicate, or appositional specification while preserving the same referent.
topics.reason: The local clause evidence allows the word to stand as a complete nominal/descriptive predication, and the nominative dual form supports the retained modifier, predicate, and appositional readings without turning the word into an accusative circumstance.

topics.headline: near-black greenness signals lush fullness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word does not merely say green or black; it names a verdant density so saturated that greenness approaches blackness.
topics.reason: V4 accepts the dark-blackness branch including lush green tending to black, and the QAC grammar marks an intensive/inherent color participle, so the local payoff is saturated dark-green state rather than ordinary green, plain black, or an externally caused darkening event.

topics.headline: overwhelming onset colors the delivery, not the gloss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the one-word image arrive as a pressure against denial, while still reading the surface sense as dark-green garden saturation.
topics.reason: The overwhelming-onset branch is an accepted root branch, but the local form and clause evidence select a nominal color predicate. The surviving point is therefore boundary pressure and delivery after the refrain, not a replacement of the color gloss.

topics.headline: the image stands between two challenges
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rhetorical move from direct challenge to a single visual exhibit that is immediately framed by the next challenge.
topics.reason: The ayah consists of one nominal/adjectival word, without a conjunction, particle, finite verb, or spoken subject, and it sits between the refrain in 55:63 and the repeated challenge in 55:65.

topics.headline: distinct green register inside the garden series
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 55:64 as the saturated-color member of a patterned garden sequence, distinct from branching abundance in 55:48, gushing motion in 55:66, and ordinary green objects in 55:76.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL inter-ayah rows give concrete same-surah contrasts: 55:48 and 55:64 each assign a compact qualifier to a garden pair, 55:66 pairs another heavy dual descriptor with the second garden panel, and 55:76 uses the ordinary green register for cushions rather than gardens.

topics.headline: recitation weight matches color density
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word's length, central doubling, and final dual closure make the brief ayah feel acoustically dense rather than slight.
topics.reason: The written and recited surface includes a long vowel, doubled middle consonant, intensive color morphology, and final -āni closure, so the sound/form observations reinforce the same saturation that the lexical topic preserves.

topics.headline: the root appears only in this dual participle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes that this single occurrence must carry the Quranic force of the root without help from other Quranic usages.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the exact root/form as a single occurrence, and the CRITICAL rows note that no other Quranic d-h-m verb, abstract noun, or alternate derivation normalizes this root outside the garden descriptor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The feminine dual form مُدْهَامَّتَانِ predicates one shared D-H-M condition of two unstated referents.
baseline_models.mechanism: D-H-M places both referents at a chromatic threshold: literal dark blackness remains available, while the same branch explicitly includes watered greenness so intense that it tends toward black.

activation_trace.role: Dark blackness, including lush watered green that nears black, supplies the threshold-color mechanism for both referents.

changed_reading.before: Two simply dark or green entities.
changed_reading.after: Two entities whose color has intensified past ordinary green into near-black depth, without prematurely choosing blackness over hyper-greenness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dual ending counts two wholes, while the D-H-M root can characterize what each whole contains or presents.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dense-multitude branch transfers darkness from a flat surface quality to internal compression: each of the two appears dark because many elements visually coalesce into a mass.

activation_trace.role: The dense-crowd image makes each dual referent an internally massed field rather than a uniform color patch.

changed_reading.before: The dual merely duplicates one color adjective.
changed_reading.after: The dual names two bounded wholes whose internal abundance resolves to the eye as dark density.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The single predicative form presents both referents as having entered or borne the same D-H-M state.
baseline_models.mechanism: The overwhelming-onset branch makes darkening eventive and pervasive: a condition has come over both referents and covered them, rather than merely assigning them a stable swatch.

activation_trace.role: The image of a sudden or pervasive coming-over supplies the directional motion by which darkness overtakes both referents.

changed_reading.before: Two objects possess a dark color.
changed_reading.after: A dark condition has spread over and saturated both objects; the word registers arrival and coverage as well as result.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The D-H-M predicate itself can carry an affective branch before any contextual noun or valuation is supplied.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dark-calamity branch leaves a live ominous charge inside the bare dual darkness. It need not determine the referents, but it prevents the color from beginning as emotionally neutral.

activation_trace.role: The dark-affliction image contributes an ominous affective residue that later context may reverse without erasing.

changed_reading.before: Darkness is a neutral visual property.
changed_reading.after: The twofold darkness initially carries the pressure of something formidable or foreboding, pending contextual recoding.

context_deltas.mechanism: Tree, bough, and garden branches convert chromatic intensity into canopy architecture: interlaced growth hides the interior and produces the near-black depth predicated by the focus.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interlocking wood, extending boughs, and a garden hidden by trees; I supply the arrow from canopy overlap to reduced light and near-black depth. Intrinsic plant color without shade causation remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Two gardens are intensely dark green.
changed_reading.after: Two gardens generate depth by their own interlaced canopy: their darkness is an effect of vegetal enclosure and hidden interior space.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context exposes two causal routes to the same dark endpoint: heat, charcoal, or smoke can blacken, while extreme greenness can also tend toward black. The local garden sequence selects the generative route but preserves the earlier destructive route as contrast.

summary.what_was_special: A one-word dual focus sustained unusually different mechanisms at once: chromatic threshold, canopy shade, hydraulic saturation, compressed biodiversity, immersive onset, and renewed persistence. Context did more than identify two gardens; it repeatedly changed what their darkness does.
remaining_uncertainties: The multitude and overwhelming-onset branches may be active cross-domain resonances rather than components of the local lexical sense.
D-W-N does not settle whether the second pair is nearer, simply other, or lower in rank.
The contrast between punitive heat-darkness and life-saturated darkness may be a reader-supplied compositional relation rather than an intended chromatic pairing.
The enclosure and gaze-limit outliers are structurally anchored but remain analogical and should not be promoted to unqualified glosses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Darkness caused by saturation.** `د ه م/B001` includes dark blackness and green tending to black from intense watering. The dual adjective directly modifies the second gardens; the gushing springs in 55:66 supply the causal cue. I infer that abundant water produces dense, nearly black greenness. The one-word ayah reads as compressed evidence of hydraulic fertility.
2. **Density rather than mere color.** `د ه م/B002` gives a dense multitude. Activated by the packed fruit inventory in 55:68, I infer an exploratory ecological reading: darkness indexes crowded growth. The ayah reads as visual density as well as hue.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:66 supplies the anticipated water mechanism and 55:68 the vegetation/fruit mechanism. Together they fill the causal arrow that the single adjective leaves unstated.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **`د ه م` `B001` — “dark blackness, including lush green tending to black from water.”** Structural cue: the bare dual adjective characterizes both gardens; within two ayat they contain two abundantly gushing springs, followed by fruit, palms, and pomegranates. Assigned role: darkness functions as the visible index of vegetal density and saturation. Packet evidence is the branch’s explicit lush-water scope and the local water-fruit sequence. Inference: abundant irrigation causes growth so deep in color that green approaches black. Reading change: the ayah signals hydrological fertility, not absence of light or a one-note color.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:66 gave direct causal support to the water-saturation image by specifying two springs whose water gushes abundantly.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A nearer or lower garden tier is intensified through dark vegetal density, forceful water, and diverse fruit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Darkness can mark danger or an overwhelming crowd, but here it is converted into the visual index of water-rich growth; retained pools and forceful spray explain how that density is sustained.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Nearer Tier and Dark Vegetal Density
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A lower or nearer enclosure becomes so saturated with growth that its green reads as blackness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: nearness below a farther limit `quranic:root_000502:B001/m01`; other or lower-ranked thing `quranic:root_000502:B003/m01`; covered garden `quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`; dense lengthening vegetation `quranic:root_000266:B011/m01`; blackness and black-green saturation `quranic:root_000496:B001/m01`; gathered multitude `quranic:root_000496:B002/m01`; overwhelming arrival `quranic:root_000496:B003/m01`; green tending toward dark `quranic:root_000418:B001/m01`; fresh green vegetation `quranic:root_000418:B002/m01`; lush ease and prosperity `quranic:root_000418:B003/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The tier is spatially "below" or nearer, but its vegetation is not diminished. Saturation compresses green into near-black, while crowd and overrunning senses make the density feel active, as if growth has occupied the whole enclosure.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade, siyahlığı çekirdek alır; hayvan rengini, bol sulanmış bitkinin siyaha yaklaşan koyu yeşilini ve gecenin karanlık bir bölümünü bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlar olarak verir. Hazırlanmış dal çerçevesi bu kapsamı doğru biçimde yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın siyahlık çekirdeği ile gece bölümü, hayvan rengi ve bol sulanmış ekin gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulmalı; özel bir kullanım bütün dalın anlamı sayılmamalıdır.

concept_map.definition: Yoğun siyahlığı veya siyaha yaklaşan belirgin koyuluğu bildirir. Hayvanın koyu rengi, bol suyla koyulaşan yeşillik ve gecenin karanlık bir bölümü bu renk çekirdeğinin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, belirgin ve yoğun siyahlık ya da siyaha yaklaşan koyuluktur.
Bol sulanmış bitkinin doygun yeşili, gözde siyaha çalacak ölçüde koyu görünür.
Hayvan rengi kullanımında beyazlığın kaybolduğu siyah ya da çok koyu post nitelenir.
Gece kullanımında gecenin karanlık bir bölümü veya gece karanlığının kendisi anlatılır.
